name: dev.mnemodb/mnemodb
description: Persistent, human-readable memory for AI agents. Memories are plain Markdown (.mem.md) in your own repo — readable, hand-editable, diffable in git. Every entry records where it came from; tool-sourced content is marked untrusted and can never override what you said.

environmentVariables.name: MNEMO_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Directory containing the .memory/ store. Leave unset to use the working directory. Setting it to an empty value is an error: the server refuses rather than writing the store somewhere that will not persist.
